name: Annette
source:
The protagonist maid.
Annette is the protagonist oldest maid, she has been serving his family since he was a child and because of that the protagonist looks up to her as a mother figure.
Due to that relationship she is reluctant at first to serve (Paizuri) the protagonist but she eventually agrees to for his sake.
